# RonEx Physiotherapy — Dehradun's Premier Physiotherapy Clinic

## Who We Are
RonEx Physiotherapy is a leading physiotherapy clinic in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. We provide advanced, evidence-based physiotherapy and rehabilitation services at our main clinic on Rajpur Road, near Clock Tower, and through home visits across 15+ areas in Dehradun.

- Physiotherapy in Dehradun (General)
